title: Chapter 440 Who Is Strong And Who Is Weak
content:
Chapter 440 Who Is Strong And Who Is Weak

"I didn't expect that this spirit and I was so powerful that even Gong Ting was no match for me."

Xuan Si frowned and then slowly stood up.

Bai Ling chuckled and said, "Isn't Xu Xingcai still there?"

Upon hearing this, Xuan Si was slightly stunned, and then he realized that Gong Ting was not from alone.

However, Xu Xingcai doesn't look like a person with any strength.

"No matter what, it's time for me to go."

After the words came to an end, Xuan Si's thoughts moved and disappeared from the spot.

And at this time, Tianjiao is in the throne.

Gong Ting's figure reappeared on the spot. His face was very bad and his mood was extremely depressed. He actually lost to Ling Qi and the Holy Spirit clan, which was a bit unacceptable.

And at this moment, the space in the distance trembled and a beautiful figure appeared there.

Xu Xingcai.

"Star Cai, I,"

When Gong Ting saw Xu Xingcai, he didn't want to face it.

However, Xu Xingcai had no surprise in his eyes, "Gong Ting, I told you that it's not simple."

Gong Ting sighed slightly and said, "Xingcai, give up directly. I don't want to kill you, and I don't want you to be killed by Ling Qi once."

When Xu Xingcai heard Gong Ting's words, he smiled softly, but this time, her smile was a little cold.

"Do you think I'm not LingJie's opponent?"

Gong Ting was silent.

Xu Xingcai continued, "Do you know that you have always given up on me since you were a child. No matter what you do, you have never asked me if I want to."

"I,,"

Gong Ting wanted to speak but stopped, but Xu Xingcai said directly: "Do you want to say that you are doing your own good?"

Xu Xingcai smiled, "I don't need it at all."

"I don't need you to think about me in everything you do, and I don't need you to give in to me when you are playing with me."

"Do you get me?"

Thoughts surge.

In the huge temple group, two somewhat tender figures were staring at each other from a distance on a martial arts performance field.

"Brother Gong Ting, come here!"

When he was a child, Xu Xingcai looked at Gong Ting opposite him, with his bright eyes full of stubbornness.

Seeing this, the mentors around him shook their heads, and even the two masters whispered: "Xingcai, don't be too arrogant, just do your best."

Gong Ting also heard what his master meant, but even if the master didn't say it, he wouldn't take any serious action.

Gong Ting was already very strong when he was a child. Xu Xingcai looked very petite in front of Gong Ting.

He looked at the small Xingcai in the distance and asked gently, "Xingcai, do you want to win?"

Xu Xingcai nodded, "Of course."

Everyone thinks she is not as good as Gong Ting. She doesn't like this. She just wants everyone to know that she is not a flower that needs other people's special care, and she is also very strong.

So the battle began.

Xu Xingcai frequently used methods, but Gong Ting only tried to dodge and kept his efforts even if he took action.

As expected, Xu Xingcai won.

But victory did not bring joy, and the mentors watching the game shook their heads slightly, as if they were just watching a joke.

The words of praise from elders in the imagination did not appear.

The little Xu Xingcai just stared at Gong Ting who was smiling and laughing, and was scolded by his master: You will make her suffer in the future if you spoil her so much.

"In the future, Gong Ting will inevitably become the pillar of the Human Emperor Palace and become an existence that can replace us."

"After all, Gong Ting is extremely talented."

"Gong Ting's heart is too soft, so he will be allowed to exercise at all times in the future."

Gong Ting, Gong Ting, the elders always talk about Gong Ting, why, why no one can see their efforts?

The little Xu Xingcai couldn't understand why she was not valued and why there was always a difference.

There were no tears on her pink little face, but since then, she has become a little silent.

Time flies, Xu Xingcai and Gong Ting are known as the two heroes of the Human Emperor Palace, but the world's eyes are more focused on Gong Ting.

Gong Ting is the face of the Human Emperor Palace. He is so dazzling. In comparison, Xu Xingcai is even more bleak.

Xu Xingcai has long been used to this.

Now, Gong Ting asked her to give up and told her not to choose to try.

This time, she no longer tolerated it.

Looking at the fighting spirit that had already begun to burn in Xu Xingcai's eyes, Gong Ting chose to accept it after an accident.

This woman he has been humble since he was a child.

“I will give it all.”

Gong Ting's eyes gradually became firmer, and he looked at Xu Xingcai and said seriously.

"Okay." Xu Xingcai also smiled.

The next moment, the two of them took action at the same time.

.........

"My Lord Palace, Mo Chou has already started to make the list."

In the Human Emperor Hall, a strong man reported to Wu Hui.

Upon hearing this, Wu Hui nodded slightly, "How are those two little guys?"

"Ming Ting lost to Ling Qi of the Holy Spirit Clan and was fighting Xingcai at this time."

"That's how it is."

Wu Hui was a little surprised, but he didn't say much.

In the announcement of the Human Emperor Palace, Gong Ting and Xu Xingcai are the strongest two young generations in the Human Emperor Palace, among which Gong Ting is the most eye-catching.

But in fact, Wu Hui didn’t know which one of them is stronger or who is weak.

Because as far as he knows, these two people have never carefully decided on the outcome.

Gong Ting is stronger, but it was fantasized by the powerful people in the Human Emperor Palace themselves. Perhaps, they are more willing to believe that Gong Ting, who has been born in a big human force, should be stronger.

As for Xu Xingcai, he was just an abandoned girl taken in by the old senior in the Human Emperor Hall from outside.

Even Xu Xingcai himself didn't know about this.

Because the old senior who took Xu Xingcai in has passed away shortly after that.

Wu Hui silently thought in his heart that this time, he could finally decide the outcome.

.........

At this time, in the palace of the Lord of the Huangcheng City.

Lu Xue suddenly opened her eyes, as if she had thought of something. With a thought, a simple mirror appeared in her hand.

Mirror of Heaven.

There is no grade divine object. As long as the user has enough strength, he can see the picture he wants to see.

"Xiaoqing, it's not that I'm not worried about you, I just want to see you, you look serious."

He murmured one after another, and then his figure was outlined in his mind.

Bai Ling said that Ao Qing actually stayed in the Heavenly Demon Clan to help the Heavenly Demon Clan quickly improve its strength in the next time.

This really doesn't look like Ao Qing's style.

There were ripples appearing with the Tianji Mirror.

A picture of arrogance and extravagance appears in the mirror of Tianji.

"Mr. Aoqing, come and catch my family."

"Lord Aoqing, he's here."

"Oh~ Lord Ao Qing, you're in love with me!"

In the picture, Ao Qing was wrapped in a black cloth belt and worked hard in the empty hall. Among them, there were a few ropes with meat tied to hang in front of her. In the center of the hall, there was a pool of fine wine. The pool of filling.

At this time, Ao Qing seemed to be tired and lay in the arms of several little dragon girls who were unclothed and beautiful as fairy. Around them, cheerful songs kept flying.

The wine pond and the meat forest are licentious and unjust!
